name: Kiko
notes: Kiko, an original chibi magical idol built from primitives in character.js (no model to download): lilac twin tails with gold star clips, a mint-and-white stage dress with a big pink bow, and a star wand. Her face is one painted decal with eight expressions; her twin tails and skirt swing on springs driven by how she really moves. The 15-second show is the shared templates/_acts/showtime.js: she pops out of the card with a ta-da, waves and winks, skips a lap round the card, dances an idol routine (step-touch with heart hands, arms waving, a point to the sky), twirls a double pirouette, cheers with confetti cannons and fireworks while the board with the card's words comes up, then shows the letter with both hands and makes a heart. One stop: a tap opens the letter.
